caveats: This record is Tatyanna Presnell's suit against the City of Spokane over her 2019 on-duty rape by former officer Nathan Nash. Spokesman (Oct 2022) says she 'filed a civil claim against the city in September 2022' (technically a claim; Spokesman Mar 2024 describes the lawsuit as filed in 2022 seeking $1 million). Settled for $300,000, approved March 2024. Nash was convicted at trial in 2022 (third-degree rape of Presnell; second-degree rape with aggravating circumstances of a second woman; acquitted of second-degree rape in Presnell's case), sentenced Oct 13, 2022 to 172 months to life; appealing. Two KREM sources failed to load (timeouts).
